content: Postgres RLS does not apply directly to views; a UNION ALL view over two RLS-enabled tables only stays safely scoped if invoked with the querying user's own permissions. On Postgres 15+ (Supabase's runtime), setting 'security_invoker = true' on the view makes it evaluate underlying RLS as the calling user, avoiding a SECURITY DEFINER-equivalent leak. Alternative proven in this codebase: a  RPC (no security definer clause) that does the UNION ALL internally — RLS on each source table auto-scopes each half of the union to the caller, same mechanism already used by dashboard_funil_detalhado (0009) and dashboard_tempo_ate_fechamento.
